sections.title: Applied project readiness
sections.text: For an entry-level role, one well-explained project can demonstrate readiness. Show the problem, your implementation choices, and what the work produced. Depth is clearer when a tool is connected to a task than when technologies are listed without a decision or outcome.

sections.title: Ownership and validation
sections.text: Show the portion of the work you delivered and how it was checked, shared, or used when applicable. A repository, demo, test, stakeholder review, or documented handoff can be useful evidence. Do not imply production deployment, testing, or impact that did not occur.
